Speaker: Peter Rahal (Founder of RXBAR and David Protein).
Company context: Built RXBAR to $600M exit to Kellogg. Built David Protein, reached $725M valuation in 255 days.
Topics Covered:

Lawsuit/PR Crisis (WLD / Brand / Strategy): Sued over calorie counts because plaintiff used a bomb calorimeter instead of metabolic measurement for EPG fat replacer. Went viral on TikTok. Handled it head-on.

EPG acquisition (COG / PRD / FIN): Acquired the supplier of their key ingredient (EPG fat replacer) to mitigate supply chain dependency risk and secure pricing power. Done via cash/equity deal. EPG lowers calories by 50% without taste compromise (ice cream, fried foods applications).

RXBAR packaging (BRD / PRD): "Three egg whites, two dates..." used negative space and ingredient transparency because "protein" claims were saturated. Contrarian design logic (gold for David, color vs flavor hierarchy).
David Protein Strategy (PRD / BRD): Wanted a weight-loss company without the stigma (Jenny Craig, etc.). Target ICP: optimizers, biohackers, models, GLP-1 users. High protein, low calorie.
Launch Mechanics (WLD / OFF / ORG): Built 6-month anticipation via LinkedIn/X, gave away 5,000 bars for free on TikTok. Had a 40k email list for launch.
Unit Economics (FIN / MEA): CPG math should work right away, 40-50% gross margin on DTC. Must factor in shipping.
Retail strategy (WLD/Growth): Small bites. Regional grocery (Wegman's, Publix) before Walmart. Failed at Walmart with RXBAR initially due to being too premium.

Marketing (MCR / BRD): Non-obvious but true ideas. David vs Goliath is obvious (bad). Boiled Cod vs David Bar is non-obvious (good). Mean Girls lawsuit response. Wrapping trucks in NY. Podcaster sponsorships (Huberman, Lane Norton).

Fundraising / M&A (FIN): Investment bankers run the process, management sells the company. LBOs (Leveraged Buyouts) in PE. PE cares about IRR and ROIC. Strategics (Kellogg) care about EPS (Earnings Per Share). MFN (Most Favored Nation) supply agreements.
